body: The technical specification for FR-RESPONSIVE-025 to 027 is kept in the change folder, and TS-RESPONSIVE-024 to 026 are defined only there. The subject file `doc/specifications/responsive-layout/technical.md` still ends at TS-RESPONSIVE-023 and has no mapping for FR-RESPONSIVE-025 to 027. This goes against the workflow (`doc/workflow/WORKFLOW.md`, stage 4: "`technical.md` per subject") and against what recent maintenance changes did: #241 and #349, for example, have no change-folder technical.md and record their TS IDs in `doc/specifications/test-suite-hygiene/technical.md`. The stated reason, "FR-RESPONSIVE-027 and TC-004 require that file to stay unchanged", is not backed by FR-RESPONSIVE-027. That requirement freezes only the text of FR-RESPONSIVE-001 to 024, the #140/#165 change records, `doc/todo/` and everything outside `doc/`; it says nothing about the subject's technical.md. The restriction was introduced by the test cases (TC-004 corner case and last command), not by the functional specification. Effects: the subject's technical spec no longer traces every FR, and the next change that edits it can reuse TS-RESPONSIVE-024 to 026, which is the risk this file itself lists. Fix: add the FR-RESPONSIVE-025..027 → TS-RESPONSIVE-024..026 mapping, with a short 'no code change' note, to `doc/specifications/responsive-layout/technical.md`. Drop the 'technical.md unchanged' corner case and the doc/ file list in TC-004, which go beyond FR-RESPONSIVE-027, and delete this change-folder technical.md through delete.txt, or reduce it to a pointer.
